figures.caption: Figure 1: From saliency to semantics on one LUDB beat. (a) A real ECG beat split into P, QRS, T, and the isoelectric background. Two samples of equal amplitude (+1.04) fall in different regions, so a per-timestep view cannot separate them. (b) GRAIL scores each region and static covariate (age, sex) on a single log-odds scale for this beat, which the model correctly classifies as LVH-absent. The prediction relies primarily on the QRS region, even though the patient’s age and T region would suggest otherwise.

Table 2: Method × metric across 6 families. faithon ↑, faithoff ↑. Bold = best in column, underline = runner-up. Sample sizes: Synth n=30, Mixed n=30, ECG n=100, LuDB n=20, FordA n=24, Wafer n=24. Every method within a family is scored on the same instances from a single run. † = GRAIL beats every baseline for every dataset with statistical significance BH q < 0.05. Paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-instance differences. FordA and Wafer carry no region annotation.

Figure 3: Owen estimator convergence in the permutation budget P , on a fixed game (synth; regions, codec and reference held fixed, only the estimator re-run). (a) the standard error falls as P−1/2 (fitted slope −0.495; the grey band is the Monte-Carlo ideal, which the measured curve sits on top of). (b) the same noise relative to mean |ϕ|. (c) region-ranking agreement with the largest-P run. The budget is measured, not assumed.

Figure 4: GRAIL region roll-ups over 40 abnormal PVC beats (shape codec, RBF, deviation-from-normal reference; ρ=0 on every beat). Bars are the mean summed Owen value per region, ±SEM; orange marks the clinical ground truth (QRS), which leads on 31/40 beats. The isoelectric bar is the aggregation of background regions. Therefore, it is split into its six constituent spans.

Table 5: Kernel ablation vs. baselines on real ECG. Exactgame kernels (n=120, ablation sweep) against the eight baselines (n=200, frozen full run): real numbers, reported side by side but not sample-paired (different n). On-manifold faithfulness ↑, localization loc-AUPRC ↑, max-sensitivity ↓, runtime s ↓; every exact-game arm has |ρ|=0 by construction. Bold = best in column. The exact game leads to faithfulness and completeness; the rougher Matérn kernels are the most robust (lowest max-sensitivity).

Figure 5: From signal to attributed regions (GRAIL, RBF, a PVC beat). (a) the beat’s segmentation into named P/QRS/T waves plus the chunked isoelectric background (bg0–bg5); (b) the same beat with the top region by Owen value shaded. The QRS complex, which is the clinical ground truth for a PVC, is the most important region (Σϕ=+5.70, a region roll-up), and the accounting is exactly complete (ρ=+0.0000). The beat is the median one among those with QRS leads in the Fig. 4 cohort, where the typical case rather than the most favorable one holds, and both figures come from a single run of a single config.

Table 8: Within-region redistribution on real data. Localization only: the profile cannot change faithfulness (the roll-up invariant), which the synth sweep confirms to three decimals. n=80 per ecg cell (8 instances × 5 tasks × 2 seeds), n=16 per ludb cell; ± is the between-seed SEM. AUPRC/AUR reward covering the annotated span, AUP/pointing reward hitting its peak—the two families disagree, and that disagreement is the result.

Table 11: Static covariates as Owen players (ludb n=40, mixed n=30; ± is the SEM over instances). Bold rows are static covariates. The remaining ones are temporal regions in the same game and the same units. On ludb, age out-scores every ECG region and is the highest-ranked player on 62.5% of instances, while sex sits an order of magnitude below it. mixed is the control: its covariates have declared roles, and the signed means recover them (shortcut and informative are 80σ and 8σ from zero, the distractor 1σ).

Figure 6: Age against the signal, LUDB LVH (n=40). Top: mean Owen value per player with the static variables in the game (bold = static, orange = the expected QRS region, unnamed background spans pooled); age carries more mass than any ECG region, sex carries little. Bottom: per instance, log2 of age’s |ϕ| over the largest |ϕ| among all temporal regions. Mass to the right of 0 is an instance where the covariate outweighs the whole signal—62% of them. The ratio is plotted rather than the raw pair because a single instance reaches |ϕ|=14 on its top region and would otherwise compress the rest into a corner.

Table 12: With statics as players vs. held fixed, paired per instance (ludb n=40, mixed n=30; ∗ = paired Wilcoxon p < 0.05). Admitting the covariates is close to free in faithfulness and localization; what it changes is the ranking. On ludb the expected-region hit rate is unmoved among signal players but falls to 0.325 once age competes with QRS.
